info.name: PE Sub Platform
info.description:
REST API collection for the PE Subscription Borrowing Base Platform.

Services
â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  pe-sub-api         http://localhost:3001   Core API
  pe-sub-extraction  http://localhost:3002   Document extraction

Sync source: pe-sub-docs/openapi.yaml v0.8.0 and pe-sub-docs/openapi-extraction.yaml v1.0.0

Before running: update the collection variables (facilityId, lpId, etc.) to match your local seed data.

Authentication â€” stateless, header-based. In gateway mode every request must carry X-Auth-User and X-Auth-Roles (set the authUser/authRoles collection variables); a missing user header returns 401, an insufficient role 403. In dev mode (default local) the API injects a fixed dev identity, so the headers are optional and may be left as-is. POST /lpRecords/ingest requires the SERVICE role; config and field-mapping mutations require ANALYST. Public routes (/ping, /health, /notifications/**) carry no headers.

request.description: The Shadow BB screen autosave/final save. Rows match persisted records by (facilityId, originalName || name); unmatched names are ignored. Present LP fields update in place. Blank cls is preserved as Unclassified rather than defaulting to Eligible. request.description: Computes and persists a new shadow BB snapshot for the facility (server-authoritative engine). An optional JSON body { lps: [...] } upserts LP input rows first — identity, classification, ratings, commitments, rates, concentration limits; engine outputs (abb, ubb, excess concentrations, rank) are not accepted and are computed and written back to lp_records by the server. Body-less POST re-runs over persisted records. Returns the snapshot with per-LP computed values incl. pctAgentBB/pctUbsBB/agentExcessM and the extended summary (totalUEC, totalUC, totalConcExcess, reclassCount).
